mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower financing costs and higher corporate cash flows.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.25% for three consecutive months, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases equity discount rates and reduces risk appetite, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has been above 0.25% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and rise in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a shift from durable goods consumption to services, weakening consumer demand and corporate revenue growth, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining HOUST and rising RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 7.5%), a decline in unemployment rate signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE > 7.5%, a decline in UNRATE fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the prior 3 months indicates strengthening labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS has increased over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 98.0 for two consecutive months, it signals a manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO has been below 98.0 for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a dual shock of slowing supply and tightening monetary policy, which depresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining INDPRO and rising FEDFUNDS fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of strong consumer spending (RSAFS growth > 1.0% YoY), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals reduced demand for durable goods, which lowers corporate revenue growth and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where RSAFS growth exceeds 1.0% YoY, a decline in HOUST fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases.
